What “running Python in Linux” means here
When I run Python, it is:

Non-interactive

Ephemeral

Single-shot execution

No persistent TTY

No attachable debugger session

I can execute Python code to completion and see outputs, but I cannot:

attach pdb interactively

step line-by-line

pause execution and wait for input

inspect live memory"
